families.label: Insider trading
families.legal_basis: FinfraG Art. 142 (Ausnützen von Insiderinformationen) – Vorschlag, durch Compliance zu bestätigen

facts.label: Own trading wish expressed
Justified with non-public inside information
Information already public
Call leaves open where the information comes from or whether it is public

rules.text: Trading wish based on non-public information from an internal source.
rules.condition: wish = yes and inside_info = yes and public != yes
rules.condition_text: "Own trading wish expressed" is yes AND "Justified with non-public inside information" is yes AND "Information already public" is not yes

rules.text: Trading wish, but the origin or publicity of the information stays open.
rules.condition: wish = yes and inside_info = unclear and public != yes
rules.condition_text: "Own trading wish expressed" is yes AND "Justified with non-public inside information" is unclear AND "Information already public" is not yes

rules.text: Trading wish; the call says that the origin or publicity of the information is open.
rules.condition: wish in [yes, unclear] and source_open = yes and public != yes
rules.condition_text: "Own trading wish expressed" is not no AND "Call leaves open where the information comes from or whether it is public" is yes AND "Information already public" is not yes

rules.text: No trading wish based on non-public information.
rules.condition: true
rules.condition_text: always

families.label: Access credentials disclosed
families.legal_basis: Interne Weisung Informationssicherheit (Zugangsdaten nie am Telefon) – Vorschlag, durch Compliance zu bestätigen

facts.label: Code/value read out on the phone
Value belongs to the current, valid process
Call leaves open whether the value is valid
Value expired or a sample
Code asked for by the advisor
Call leaves open which process the value belongs to

rules.text: A valid access value was spoken on the phone.
rules.condition: spoken = yes and current = yes and expired_or_sample != yes
rules.condition_text: "Code/value read out on the phone" is yes AND "Value belongs to the current, valid process" is yes AND "Value expired or a sample" is not yes

rules.text: A value was read out, but it is unclear which process it belongs to or whether it is valid.
rules.condition: spoken = yes and validity_open = yes and expired_or_sample != yes
rules.condition_text: "Code/value read out on the phone" is yes AND "Call leaves open whether the value is valid" is yes AND "Value expired or a sample" is not yes

rules.text: A value was (possibly) read out; the call says that validity or process are open.
rules.condition: spoken in [yes, unclear] and (validity_open = yes or process_open = yes) and expired_or_sample != yes
rules.condition_text: "Code/value read out on the phone" is not no AND ("Call leaves open whether the value is valid" is yes OR "Call leaves open which process the value belongs to" is yes) AND "Value expired or a sample" is not yes

rules.text: No valid access value spoken.
rules.condition: true
rules.condition_text: always

families.label: Information given to third parties
families.legal_basis: BankG Art. 47 (Bankkundengeheimnis) – Vorschlag, durch Compliance zu bestätigen

facts.label: Concrete data of a third person given out
Information about a third person requested
Power of attorney / right to information confirmed
No power of attorney / authorization established
Information beyond the scope of the power of attorney
Call leaves open whether an authorization exists

rules.text: Data of a third person given out although authorization was found to be missing.
rules.condition: data_given = yes and not_authorized = yes
rules.condition_text: "Concrete data of a third person given out" is yes AND "No power of attorney / authorization established" is yes

rules.text: Information beyond the confirmed scope of the power of attorney.
rules.condition: data_given = yes and beyond_scope = yes
rules.condition_text: "Concrete data of a third person given out" is yes AND "Information beyond the scope of the power of attorney" is yes

rules.text: Data of a third person given out, authorization not confirmed.
rules.condition: data_given = yes and authorized != yes
rules.condition_text: "Concrete data of a third person given out" is yes AND "Power of attorney / right to information confirmed" is not yes

rules.text: Information about a third person requested, authorization stays unresolved.
rules.condition: third_party_request = yes and authorized = unclear and not_authorized = unclear
rules.condition_text: "Information about a third person requested" is yes AND "Power of attorney / right to information confirmed" is unclear AND "No power of attorney / authorization established" is unclear

rules.text: Information about a third person requested; the call says the authorization is unresolved.
rules.condition: (third_party_request in [yes, unclear] or data_given in [yes, unclear]) and authorization_open = yes and authorized != yes and not_authorized != yes
rules.condition_text: ("Information about a third person requested" is not no OR "Concrete data of a third person given out" is not no) AND "Call leaves open whether an authorization exists" is yes AND "Power of attorney / right to information confirmed" is not yes AND "No power of attorney / authorization established" is not yes

rules.text: No unauthorized information given to third parties.
rules.condition: true
rules.condition_text: always

families.label: Withholding relevant information
families.legal_basis: FIDLEG Art. 15 (Dokumentation) / interne Weisung Kreditprüfung – Vorschlag, durch Compliance zu bestätigen

facts.label: Asked not to record something
Hidden fact is relevant
Only a correction or private details
Call leaves open whether the hidden information is relevant

rules.text: A relevant obligation is to be hidden from the responsible office.
rules.condition: omit_request = yes and relevant = yes and correction_or_private != yes
rules.condition_text: "Asked not to record something" is yes AND "Hidden fact is relevant" is yes AND "Only a correction or private details" is not yes

rules.text: Something is to be hidden; whether it is relevant stays open.
rules.condition: omit_request = yes and relevant = unclear and correction_or_private != yes
rules.condition_text: "Asked not to record something" is yes AND "Hidden fact is relevant" is unclear AND "Only a correction or private details" is not yes

rules.text: Something is to be hidden; the call says it is open whether it is relevant.
rules.condition: omit_request in [yes, unclear] and relevance_open = yes and correction_or_private != yes
rules.condition_text: "Asked not to record something" is not no AND "Call leaves open whether the hidden information is relevant" is yes AND "Only a correction or private details" is not yes

rules.text: No relevant information is to be withheld.
rules.condition: true
rules.condition_text: always

families.label: Splitting to bypass a control
families.legal_basis: GwG (Sorgfaltspflichten) / interne Kompetenzordnung – Vorschlag, durch Compliance zu bestätigen

facts.label: Splitting into partial amounts requested
Purpose is to bypass a control or approval
Partial amounts belong to a single invoice
Independent invoices or only an example
Call leaves open whether the partial amounts belong together
Call leaves open why the payment should be split
One connected payment is to be split into partial payments
Reason given - approval / check / responsibility should not apply

rules.text: Splitting a payment to bypass an internal control.
rules.condition: split_request = yes and avoid_control = yes and single_invoice != no and harmless != yes
rules.condition_text: "Splitting into partial amounts requested" is yes AND "Purpose is to bypass a control or approval" is yes AND "Partial amounts belong to a single invoice" is not no AND "Independent invoices or only an example" is not yes

rules.text: One connected payment is to be split so that an approval or check does not apply.
rules.condition: split_connected = yes and approval_avoided = yes and harmless != yes
rules.condition_text: "One connected payment is to be split into partial payments" is yes AND "Reason given - approval / check / responsibility should not apply" is yes AND "Independent invoices or only an example" is not yes

rules.text: Partial amounts requested, but the connection or motive stays unclear.
rules.condition: split_request = yes and avoid_control = unclear and harmless != yes
rules.condition_text: "Splitting into partial amounts requested" is yes AND "Purpose is to bypass a control or approval" is unclear AND "Independent invoices or only an example" is not yes

rules.text: Partial amounts requested; the call says the connection of the receipts or the motive is open.
rules.condition: (split_request in [yes, unclear] or split_connected in [yes, unclear]) and (link_open = yes or motive_open = yes) and harmless != yes
rules.condition_text: ("Splitting into partial amounts requested" is not no OR "One connected payment is to be split into partial payments" is not no) AND ("Call leaves open whether the partial amounts belong together" is yes OR "Call leaves open why the payment should be split" is yes) AND "Independent invoices or only an example" is not yes

rules.text: No splitting to bypass a control.
rules.condition: true
rules.condition_text: always
